The '''Junior Chancellor''' was the mock-equivalent of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]]. [[Kennis Radi]] was Junior Chancellor in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during a mock vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].
